headline: Government approves Aena's new investment plan and caps fare increases at three cents per passenger
summary: The Spanish government approved Aena's new investment plan of 13,000 million and trimmed the proposed tariff path. Fare increases are capped at three cents per passenger.
why: Aena operates Spain's airports, and its tariffs and investment plans are set under regulation that determines its revenue and capital spending.

impacts.name: Aena
impacts.why: The approved plan funds investment but caps fare increases, which limits tariff-driven revenue growth.
